title: 第十二章：桃源古镇-《道士下山之749局》
content:
第(1/3)页

    杨童追到密道入口，发现通道狭窄幽深，布满了蛛网，显然是早就备好的退路。

    “追不追？”

    胡九郎走到玉佩碎裂的地方，捡起一块碎片，碎片上还残留着微弱的邪气。

    “不必追了,对方速度很快，而且这里凶吉不明，通往何处也不知道，追进去容易出事！”

    胡九郎指尖摩挲着碎片，林佳问道:

    “他真的不是那晚的刺客？”

    林佳的眼神极好，是看清楚那晚的刺客身形和相貌的，此人跟那人极为相似，难免会有所怀疑和疑惑。

    “此人的术法路数与暗杀者截然不同，那个此刻用的是淬毒的符篆，手法狠辣直接，而这个人擅长阵法和遁术，邪气中带着几分道家旁门的影子，只是形似，绝非同一人。”

    林佳蹲下身检查毒蝎的尸体，毒蝎体内藏着细小的符咒碎片。

    “这是什么？”

    胡九郎眼神深邃，说道：

    “这些是桃源古镇的东西！”

    “桃源古镇？那是什么地方？何以我从未听过？”

    杨童对此大为不解。

    胡九郎叹息道：

    “桃源古镇是一个荒废的古镇，我曾去过那里取桃木，那里有一个千年桃木，效果极佳，这玉佩也是出自桃源古镇的一块石头……”

    杨童眯了一下眼睛。

    “你是说那是荒废的地方？”

    胡九郎肯定的点了点头。

    “既已荒废，那么……倒是方便他们行事……”

    胡九郎“嗯”了一声，发现杨童眼神带着一丝疑窦。

    “这玉石只有桃源古镇有，十分独特，我也曾去过一些，自然知道！”

    杨童问道：

    “你去桃源古镇，真的只是为了桃木？”

    胡九郎坦然道：

    “我没有必要撒谎，本来我可以不说的！只是不希望你……为了追查真相，要去追进这个密道，这很危险！”

    杨童看向胡九郎，语气带着几分笃定。

    “胡先生，看来这次你又得跟我们走一趟了。”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Yang Tong chased to the entrance of the secret passage and found that the passage was narrow, deep and covered with cobwebs. Apparently, he had prepared an escape route.

"Would you like to pursue me or not?"

Hu Jiulang walked to the place where the jade pendant was broken and picked up a fragment. There was still a faint evil spirit on the fragment.

“There’s no need to chase, the opponent is very fast, and the bad luck here is unknown, and we don’t know where it is leading to. It’s easy to get into trouble if we chase him in!”

Hu Jiulang rubbed the fragments with his fingertips, and Lin Jia asked:

"He was really not the assassin that night?"

Lin Jia’s eyes were very good, and she could clearly see the figure and appearance of the assassin that night. This person was very similar to that person, so it was inevitable that she would have doubts and doubts.

"This person's method of magic is completely different from that of the assassin. That person is using poison-tempered talismans at the moment, and his techniques are ruthless and direct, while this person is good at formations and escape techniques, and his evil aura has some shadows of Taoism. They are just similar in appearance, and they are definitely not the same person."

Lin Jia knelt down and inspected the body of the poisonous scorpion. There were tiny talisman fragments hidden inside the poisonous scorpion.

"What is this?"

Hu Jiulang said with deep eyes:

"These are things from Taoyuan Ancient Town!"

"Taoyuan Ancient Town? What is that place? Why have I never heard of it?"

Yang Tong was very puzzled by this.

Hu Jiulang sighed:

"Taoyuan Ancient Town is an abandoned ancient town. I once went there to get peach wood. There is a thousand-year-old peach wood there, which has excellent effect. This jade pendant is also a stone from Taoyuan Ancient Town..."

Yang Tong narrowed his eyes.

"You mean that's a deserted place?"

Hu Jiulang nodded affirmatively.

"Since it is abandoned, then...it will be convenient for them to do..."

Hu Jiulang said "hmm" and found Yang Tong's eyes filled with suspicion.

"This kind of jade can only be found in Taoyuan Ancient Town. It is very unique. I have been to some before, so I know it!"

Yang Tong asked:

"You went to Taoyuan Ancient Town, really just for the peach trees?"

Hu Jiulang said calmly:

"There is no need for me to lie. I didn't have to say anything! I just don't want you to... pursue this secret passage in order to find out the truth. This is very dangerous!"

Yang Tong looked at Hu Jiulang with a certain tone in his tone.

"Mr. Hu, it seems you have to come with us again this time."
